title: harnesspm.json
description: Project configuration for harnesspm, the harness package manager. Every field is optional.

exclude.description: Packages or unit IDs to drop, such as "@tenphi/glaze" or "tasty:rules/legacy".

replace.description: Unit ID → path of a project file that takes its place.

patch.description: Rule ID → path of a patch that changes some of its sections.

trust.description: Packages whose executable units may run: true follows upgrades, "pin" needs an approval for each new version.
